Sudoku Skill v0.1.2

- Refreshed and condensed documentation for clarity and easier reference.
- Added "share" command for generating SudokuPad, SCL, or fpuzzles share links.
- Updated render commands: now use `render` for image/PDF output instead of `puzzle`.

- No functional or API changes—documentation update only.

Sudoku skill initial release:

- Fetches Sudoku puzzles from sudokuonline.io and stores them as JSON files in the workspace.
- Generates puzzle images (PNG) and printable A4 PDFs on demand from stored JSON.
- Supports multiple puzzle types: Kids 4x4, Kids 6x6, and Classic 9x9 (Easy/Medium/Hard/Evil).
- Offers solution reveal only on explicit user request (full board, single box, or single cell).
- Provides SudokuPad share links for Classic 9x9 puzzles with Telegram-safe encoding.
- Designed for clean image sharing and optimal Telegram presentation (image & link handling).
